causal_contract.asymmetric_mitigation: Within the frozen window, exactly one asset reaches the frozen mitigation depth while its peer remains beyond its own near FVG edge plus the frozen hold buffer.
causal_contract.fvg: At completed bar t, bullish FVG is low[t] > high[t-2] with bullish displacement body at t-1; bearish is high[t] < low[t-2] with bearish displacement.
causal_contract.reclaim: The mitigated asset must close back beyond its frozen FVG midpoint or near edge in the displacement direction; entry is the following bar open.
causal_contract.same_bar_exit: Stop before target; adverse observed open for stop gaps.
causal_contract.stop: Frozen FVG far edge or observed mitigation extreme plus ATR buffer.
causal_contract.synchronization: Both assets in a fixed pair must complete an FVG in the same direction at the same timestamp.
causal_contract.target: Previous UTC day or previous ISO week external liquidity in the displacement direction, known before entry.
causal_contract.unresolved: No elapsed-time liquidation; unresolved positions are recorded and fail the stage gate.

trader_explanation.name: FVG-Mitigation SMT Continuation
sequence: Two correlated contracts displace in the same direction and print a same-time FVG.
One contract retraces into its imbalance while the peer refuses to mitigate its own gap.
That non-confirmation is the SMT signal: the peer shows relative strength or weakness.
The retracing contract reclaims consequent encroachment in the original displacement direction.
Enter the retracing contract next bar, stop beyond the failed mitigation, and target opposing external liquidity.
